_comment: MarginIQ project registry. Add a new platform by adding an entry under 'projects' - no code change needed. 'param_aliases' maps a log's START_RMT header name to the tool's canonical parameter name (e.g. WCL prints RxVref where NVL prints RxDqVrefByte). 'axis_config' is the default Y-axis JSON for that project (relative to the repo root).
